chunks: 30 - Ahmad ibn Hawtha al-Bahili narrated to us, saying: Ibrahim ibn Ishaq an-Nahawandi narrated to us, saying: Abdullah ibn Hammad al-Ansari narrated to us, from Abdullah ibn Bukayr, from Hamran ibn A'yun, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) that he said:

"As if I see your religion agitating, being examined with its blood, and then no one will restore it to you except a man from us, the Ahl al-Bayt. He will give you two gifts in the year and provide you with two livelihoods in the month. You will be granted wisdom in his time, to the extent that a woman can judge in her house by the Book of Allah, the Exalted, and the Sunnah of the Messenger of Allah."

key_terms.أَهْلُ الْبَيْتِ: The People of the House, referring to the Prophet's family and Imams
key_terms.الْحِكْمَةَ: Wisdom, referring to deep spiritual and practical knowledge
key_terms.تَقْضِي: She judges, referring to the ability to derive rulings
key_terms.عَطَاءَيْنِ: Two gifts, referring to material provision
key_terms.مُتَخَضْضِضًا: Agitating or trembling, describing the state of the religion
key_terms.يُفْحَصُ بِدَمِهِ: Being examined/tested with its blood, referring to bloodshed and conflict

ai.seo_question: What are the signs of the restoration of religion by the Ahl al-Bayt according to Imam al-Baqir?
ai.summary: In this narration from Imam al-Baqir, the anticipated Qa'im is depicted as the restorer of divine justice who reverses the era of bloodshed with an era of abundance, granting double sustenance and wisdom. The profound depth of this wisdom is such that even a woman within her household can independently derive legal rulings directly from the Quran and Sunnah, reflecting the widespread dissemination of knowledge during his reign.

en.abdullah-al-shahin: (30) Ahmad bin Hawtha al-Bahili narrated from Ibraheem bin Iss’haq an-Nahawandi from Abdullah bin Hammad al-Ansari from Abdullah bin Bukayr from Hamran bin A’yun that Abu Ja’far al-Baqir (as) had said:

“As if I see your religion agitating in its blood and then no one will restore it as it has been before except a man from us Ahlul Bayt. He will give you two gifts a year and two livelihoods a month. You will be granted with wisdom at his time until a woman can judge with the Book of Allah and the Sunna of the Prophet (S) in her house.”
